description: The 30 January beach action is reported across Cape Town and Plettenberg Bay. Reports identify shared calls and groups, but the relation among all sites and organizers is not settled; Port Elizabeth was advertised but actual attendance there was not verified.
required_followup: Review site-by-site organizers and occurrence evidence; decide whether the Cape Town and Plettenberg Bay actions are one coordinated campaign or separate local events. Seek occurrence evidence for Port Elizabeth before adding it to the location.

description: For Muizenberg on 30 January, police estimate about 200 while the protest organizer estimated 400–500. These are conflicting estimates for one site. No total across locations is available.
required_followup: Preserve the conflicting Muizenberg counts; do not sum separate sites. Seek additional contemporaneous site counts only if they directly measure attendance.

description: At Muizenberg, TimesLIVE says police retreated after trying to disperse the crowd; IOL and News24 carry the police account that the crowd was peacefully removed. The Plettenberg Bay arrest is site-specific and reportedly followed a mask-related altercation.
required_followup: Keep the competing reports and site attribution. Verify whether other reliable accounts clarify the removal outcome or Plettenberg arrest; do not infer physical end from the last report.

description: A group involved in the 30 January beach action planned a Fish Hoek demonstration for 6 February. SABC confirms later We Are More protest action, but no evidence establishes uninterrupted physical action between the dates or attendance above 50 in February.
required_followup: The February unit should decide whether the 6 February Fish Hoek action is a new episode or a continuation of the beach-closure campaign, and seek its participant count. Do not extend the January event date on current evidence.

description: The City of Cape Town and Western Cape Government requested beach reopening before 30 January; beaches reopened from 2 February. No source attributes the policy change to the protest.
required_followup: Keep accommodation unknown unless a source directly links a post-protest reception or policy action to the protest. Treat the prior City/Western Cape request and subsequent national change as chronology, not proven causal response.

description: The 27 January Durban surfers’ protest is described only as a group; no count or size estimate is reported.
required_followup: Seek contemporaneous attendance estimates and exact beach; retain the candidate as pending threshold unless a credible count is found.

description: The KaBokweni road blockade is described as a group of unemployed youth, without count or exact event day. The article headline calls it violent, but the body does not describe violence.
required_followup: Seek another contemporary report for the exact day, attendance, road, organizer, physical end and any described violence or state response.

description: Two marker work-stoppage sequences occurred at Humansdorp within days: a 11–12 January transport/PPE stoppage, then reported COVID-safety protests at Humansdorp and OR Tambo on 14 January and Stutterheim on 16 January. No source establishes whether they were related or continuous.
required_followup: Review whether the later COVID-related actions were a continuation, escalation or separate dispute. Do not merge based on one province, workplace or marker workforce alone.

description: Marker reports describe work stoppages but no public gathering. The 151 Stutterheim figure counts markers who downed tools; it is not reported as an assembled crowd, and the other centres have no headcounts.
required_followup: Review original inclusion rules for workplace stoppages and seek evidence of public assembly or a count of people participating in any external protest. Do not convert workforce size into crowd turnout.

description: The January Uber Eats action is well reported as an offline stay-away with some roadside groups, but public attendance is not quantified; the 80% figure refers to a 2,000-driver workforce and cannot be used as crowd size.
required_followup: Retain the figure/source distinction and date conflict; search only for a credible count of people at any public gathering, not workforce participation.

description: Citizen reports the 18–19 December Uber Eats fee stoppage was suspended pending a company response. The reported 21/22 January action followed weeks later; no source documents continuous physical action between them.
required_followup: Preserve December as a separate older action unless evidence establishes continuous physical mobilization into January. The January date conflict remains unresolved.

description: Some relevant pages were not readable: the Citizen report on arrest calls returned HTTP 403 after one exact-URL request; the SABC beach-protest report timed out; other pages returned browser cache misses and remain search-only when not otherwise recovered.
required_followup: Respect the 403 and do not retry or bypass. Preserve timeouts/cache misses as limitations; rely on other opened sources for event fields.

description: Discovery attempts were made in Afrikaans, isiZulu and isiXhosa, but the search results were mostly irrelevant and no substantial contemporary reporting in these languages was verified. Other South African languages were not systematically covered.
required_followup: A later review with language-specific local sources or fluent verification is needed; do not infer absence from the limited discovery.

description: Open-web searching is not equivalent to systematic newspaper archives; date filters and domain operators often returned unrelated years. The official latest baseline universe, codebook bytes and additional coding procedure remain unverified for the project.
required_followup: Coordinator must resolve the official baseline and archive access before any integration. Treat the current open-web dossier as provisional and non-exhaustive.

description: TimesLIVE's October 2021 report describes a midnight protest on January 1 in Zamdela but does not state the event year. The report's publication year is not used to infer that the event occurred on 1 January 2021.
required_followup: Seek contemporaneous local reporting or a court/police record that states the year before assigning this event to January 2021.

description: The retrospective says a larger group was involved but gives no number or scale. The reported two convictions are not a crowd count.
required_followup: Seek a reliable estimate of attendees at the road blockade; retain pending evidence if no threshold-sized public gathering can be established.

description: A cross-province search surfaced a Department of Cooperative Governance report excerpt about a 12 January 2021 court order concerning Kgetlengrivier water and sewage operations. It describes a court agreement and residents' service operation, not a verified public gathering; opening the PDF timed out. This is a North West lead requiring separation of governance action from public mobilization.
required_followup: If later review finds evidence of a public gathering connected to Kgetlengrivier, verify its occurrence and size separately. Do not treat the court agreement or resident service operation alone as a protest.
